info.title: Browser Use Universal API
info.description: Browser Use provides managed AI browser automation, persistent browser sessions, profiles, workspaces, files, and account billing APIs.

post.description: Creates a browser session in Browser Use.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

allowResizing.description: Whether to allow browser resizing during the session.

browserScreenHeight.description: Custom browser screen height in pixels.

browserScreenWidth.description: Custom browser screen width in pixels.

profileId.description: Profile ID to use for the browser session.

proxyCountryCode.description: Proxy country code. Defaults to us; null disables proxy.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

post.description: Creates a session or dispatches a task in Browser Use.

agentmail.description: Whether to provision a temporary AgentMail inbox.

enableRecording.description: Whether to record the browser session.

enableScheduledTasks.description: Whether the agent may create scheduled tasks.

keepAlive.description: Keep the session idle after the task completes so follow-up tasks can reuse it.

maxCostUsd.description: Maximum allowed cost in USD for this session.

model.description: Model to use, such as claude-sonnet-4.6, gemini-3-flash, or claude-opus-4.6.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema object for structured task output.

profileId.description: Browser profile ID to load into the session.

proxyCountryCode.description: Proxy country code such as us, de, or jp. Set null to disable proxy.

sessionId.description: Existing idle session ID to dispatch the task to.

skills.description: Whether to enable built-in Browser Use skills.

task.description: Natural-language instruction for the agent to execute.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID to attach to the session.
